start.title: Files that will not sync because their path is too long
start.body: OneDrive and SharePoint refuse any item whose full web path is longer than 400 characters, counting the library address, every folder and the file name. PathShrink finds those items and shortens folder names, first without removing any letter. Nothing changes until you review and confirm.

side.margin.hint: Fix paths this close to the limit too, so the next longer file name does not fail again. Recommended: 20.
side.trim.hint: Cuts letters from the end of the longest folder names. File names only when no folder can give more.
side.minName.hint: Never trim a name below this length. Recommended: 20.
side.exclude.hint: Wildcards on a name or path. Not scanned, not renamed. Example: Archive*
side.prefix.hint: Leave empty to detect it. For a copied folder, type the library path, e.g. sites/Legal/Shared Documents/
side.replan.tip: Recalculate the plan. Scope changes rescan the folder.
